hints.title: Mirror, not identity
hints.body: The left subtree and the right subtree should not be identical; they should be mirror images. Which child of the left subtree pairs with which child of the right subtree?

hints.title: Pair the outside and the inside
hints.body: For two nodes `left` and `right`, compare their values, then compare `left.left` with `right.right` and `left.right` with `right.left`. If either pair fails, the tree is not symmetric.

hints.title: Use a queue of pairs
hints.body: Start with the pair `(root.left, root.right)`. Repeatedly take a pair. If both are null, continue. If exactly one is null, return false. If their values differ, return false. Otherwise add the two mirrored child pairs to the queue.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
if root is null:
    return true
queue = [(root.left, root.right)]
while queue is not empty:
    left, right = remove front
    if left is null and right is null:
        continue
    if left is null or right is null:
        return false
    if left.val != right.val:
        return false
    queue.append((left.left, right.right))
    queue.append((left.right, right.left))
return true
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution. Translate it into your language and check it against the examples.
